messages:
rachel: quick note from the zephyr2-int4 canary: structured-output compliance dropped vs fp16 on our funcall schema set, parse success 84%.
jamal: yikes, any sample?
rachel: here's a typical fail: ```json
{"intent": "update", "payload": {"user_id": "42", "flags": [true,false,],}}
```
alex: trailing comma in array + numeric id encoded as string. strict-json parser rejects.
eva: we should try a schema-guided pre-parser that uses the model schema to coerce->types and remove common noise. low-risk if we run only in canary.
canary-bot: Canary summary 2026-03-21T10:00Z: zephyr2-int4 parse_ok=84% | fp16 parse_ok=99% | sample_n=500
jamal: prototyped a pre-parse stage: steps = [strip_trailing_commas, fix_single_quotes, coerce_numeric_strings(schema), normalize_booleans] — pseudo 30 LOC. On n=100 probe: parse_ok->94%, but 2 samples changed semantics (string "0" -> number 0 where semantics differ).
rachel: list the changed semantics. we need audit logs for any repair that alters meaning.
jamal: added auditing: save (orig, repaired, schema_path, diff_hint) to s3://ml-canary/zephyr2/1713619999/changes.jsonl
alex: also track tokenization deltas; sometimes quantized models emit extra commas or stray escape chars because of token boundaries.
eva: good call. add delta_tokens field.
deploy-bot: estimated cost of falling back to fp16 for these endpoints: 2.1x compute.
rachel: rollout plan proposal: 1) run full 1k canary with pre-parse enabled, 2) measure parse_ok and QA-match (semantic fidelity) vs fp16 baseline, 3) if parse_ok >=97% and QA-match drop <=0.5% keep int4 with pre-parse in canary only; else rollback int4 and investigate quantization kernels.
jamal: will also run an alternative: "repair-then-validate" where we attempt repair, then run a lightweight semantic checksum (prompt-based QA) to detect meaning flips. cheap: ~0.05 tokens per request because it's local.
rachel: timeline: canary job queued now, ETA ~90m. please monitor s3 logs and summary metric: repair_semantic_change_rate.
canary-bot: Job queued: canary/zephyr2-int4/schema-guided-repair/1713619999
alex: if repair_semantic_change_rate > 0.5% then capture 200 examples for offline human review.
eva: add an eval histogram for per-schema key failure rates (some schemas worse).
jamal: acked, instrumentation added. logging prefixes: X-CANARY-ID:1713619999, X-REPAIR-MODE:schema-guided
rachel: thanks team :thumbsup:
